decisions.pair call: lead, 2026-11-20, on the user's cell text ('reuse / new / no call by the every-seed rule on all nine pairs, twins and grafts'): the pair-relative every-seed call below, the share's own pair rule; no per-fine-tune cut-off

thresholds.thresholds_source: self_act_diff, self_rn_dev, fve_early, fve_min, dead_max, planted_part, planted_lead_specific: E203/E212 filed bars (experiments/crosscoder/results/run2/predictions.json, experiments/realistic_tasks/results/predictions_run3.json); curve_step, fve_curve_min: E212; planted_lead_specific false (E203/E212 had true): a grafted head's change spreads over many latents, unlike E203's single planted direction; in the rehearsal (job 62445) the largest single latent carried 1-20% of a head's change, so the lead-latent clause tests which one latent carries most, not whether the method sees the change; the part carried by fine-tune-specific latents, at least planted_part, is the bar; spliced_recovered_drop: E203's fve_drop (0.05) applied to the recovered fraction against the site's self crosscoder; projected_limit_min: about three times the per-crosscoder estimate (A 28, B 32 min; E203 timing.json and side minutes), so a card running two crosscoders at once (each slower) passes and a stalled stream does not; graft_energy_min: the self control's change is exactly 0, so any graft write above rounding (activations are O(1)-O(100) per token) passes; the rehearsal keeps the exact bars and relaxes only those a tiny dictionary cannot meet

readings.count: the authors' native output: latents among the top_n by relative norm with nu_r < 0.5 and nu_eps < 0.2 (commute.crosscoder.specific); top_n_wide beside
readings.specific: the share of the side's activation change D(x) = h_ft - h_base at the site carried by those latents, sum of s_j (commute.crosscoder.carried), on the side's read rows
readings.d, d_alt: E203's forms (commute.crosscoder.d_forms), reported beside, never scored
readings.fit: FVE per model on Pile val rows plus the read rows, dead share, L0, spliced loss (clean, spliced, mean-ablated next-token loss on spliced_rows Pile val rows per model; recovered = (ablated - spliced) / (ablated - clean))
readings.energy: mean squared activation change per token at the site on the read rows

S0a self (stop).rule: per site, in its own job: a zero update's activations within self_act_diff of W0's before training; at the end max |relative norm - 0.5| over alive latents <= self_rn_dev; count 0; min FVE >= fve_min; dead <= dead_max. Any miss: exit 1; `check0` marks the site failed.
S0a self (stop).blind_to: anything a real change could do; it fails only on a code fault (side mix-up, a path that does not reproduce W0)
S0a self (stop).edge_cases: specific is nan by construction (zero change): not compared; no alive latent: the deviation is nan, a miss

S0b grafted head (stop).rule: per site, on every crosscoder seed (`check0`): specific >= planted_part (and the lead latent, the alive latent with the largest s_j on the head's read rows, fine-tune-specific only if planted_lead_specific; false here, see thresholds_source). A miss on any seed or a missing seed: the site's planted control failed; its stage-1 items refuse; told to the user; the site reads 'not applicable at this update size'.
S0b grafted head (stop).blind_to: changes the head does not make (it tests detection of machinery M lacks, not of a reweighted mechanism)
S0b grafted head (stop).edge_cases: graft energy at its site <= graft_energy_min: a build fault, exit 1 before training; for the B head, any change at site A over self_act_diff: exit 1; lead latent nan betas (never fired on the latent-scaling tokens): not specific, a miss; ties in s_j: lowest index is the lead

G1 Gaussian false new.rule: per site (`check1`): on any crosscoder seed the matched Gaussian passes the planted bar (as S0b reads it): fail; the reading calls a structureless change new, so graft calls at that site are not read.
G1 Gaussian false new.edge_cases: Gaussian match outside gauss_match_tol after bisection: exit 1 before training; a missing seed: fail

G2 Gaussian as reuse-like as reuse.rule: per site (`check1`): pass iff min over the Gaussian's seeds of specific > max over the primary pair's reuse-side values (3 fine-tune seeds at crosscoder seed 0, and crosscoder seeds 1-2 on fine-tune seed 0), strict. Fail: pair calls at that site read 'not applicable at this update size'.
G2 Gaussian as reuse-like as reuse.blind_to: whether a Gaussian 'should' read new: it checks only that the reading places a change with no structure apart from a reuse fine-tune, as the share's random control does (E228)
G2 Gaussian as reuse-like as reuse.edge_cases: all zero (Gaussian 0, reuse 0): 0 > 0 is false, so fail (the lean outcome); a missing file or a nan: fail

early checks (each crosscoder; stop).rule: before step 0: stream tokens >= steps x batch; every step: finite loss; at curve_step: batch FVE >= fve_curve_min; at the first snapshot (12.5% of tokens): min FVE >= fve_early, dead <= dead_max, projected minutes <= projected_limit_min; at the end: every step trained, min FVE >= fve_min, dead <= dead_max. Each logs its reading and the projected minutes when it passes. Spliced recovered >= the site's self value - spliced_recovered_drop is read by `check1` (it needs the self crosscoder) and a miss marks that item unread.

pair call (the primary pair here; the ni.rule: per site, values v = specific of each listed fine-tune at crosscoder seed 0: 'reuse/new as built' if min(v_new) > max(v_reuse); 'reversed' if max(v_new) < min(v_reuse); else 'no call'. Gap = mean(v_new) - mean(v_reuse) (positive = with the build). Read only at a site whose S0a, S0b and G2 passed; otherwise 'not applicable at this update size'.
pair call (the primary pair here; the ni.edge_cases: ties anywhere between the sides: neither strict inequality holds, 'no call'; all values 0: 'no call'; fewer than 2 values on a side: 'not read'; a nan: 'not read'

graft call (run 2, site B; stated here s.rule: per graft, on every crosscoder seed the planted bar as S0b reads it: 'new'; on no seed: 'not new'; otherwise 'no call'. Read only if S0a, S0b and G1 passed at B.
graft call (run 2, site B; stated here s.edge_cases: one seed lost: 'not read'; the do-nothing state (self) under this rule reads 'not new' (specific nan fails >=), never 'new'

rules.run 2 decision (`check1` writes it): A readable for pairs: S0a, S0b, G2 pass at A. B readable for grafts: S0a, S0b, G1 pass at B. Both: run 2 as planned. Only B: run 2 is the four grafts at B. Neither: run 2 is not run; the crosscoder reads 'not applicable at this update size' at both sites.
rules.C (controls): S0a pass at both sites (high); S0b pass at B (medium), at A (low-medium); G1 pass at both (medium-high); G2 FAIL at A (lean, medium: rival b)
rules.reported, not scored: per crosscoder: count at top_n and top_n_wide, specific, d, d_alt, parts, lead latent with its betas, FVE, dead, L0, spliced loss, energy, trained steps and tokens, task share, minutes; per site the range of each reading over crosscoder seeds (fine-tune seed 0) and over fine-tune seeds (crosscoder seed 0), the noise floor; the k sweep; E203's planted direction

edge_case_checks.pair call, all zero: v_reuse [0,0,0], v_new [0,0,0]: min(new) 0 > max(reuse) 0 false; max(new) 0 < min(reuse) 0 false; 'no call'
edge_case_checks.pair call, two-seed side: reuse [0, 0.003], new [0.01, 0.02, 0.03]: 0.01 > 0.003: a call; one value only: 'not read'
edge_case_checks.pair call, do-nothing as a side: self's specific is nan; a nan makes the pair 'not read', so a zero update can never earn a call
edge_case_checks.G2, lean outcome: gauss [0,0,0], reuse [0,0,0,0,0]: 0 > 0 false: fail, 'not applicable at this update size'
edge_case_checks.S0b, empty candidate pool: no latent passes nu: count 0, specific 0 < 0.5: miss

blind_to.specific: a change in how the model uses a direction it already represents; changes outside the site; leans toward shared latents by construction (joint loss)
blind_to.Gaussian match: the direction of the activation change; it matches only its size at one site
